metadata.explanation: Extends the original single-location subscript task to two locations: the Title paragraph and the first body paragraph containing 'H2O—SOAK UP THE SCIENCE'. Getter checks for a run with '2' and subscript=True in each location. Partial credit: 0.5 per location. Initial state fails negative control (both subscript values are None in original document). [Fixed: renamed functions from invalid 8-char suffix '385efeaf' to valid 32-char MD5 hash 'cb7672ac12071a9e4c398d11dc4c470e' computed from '0b17a146-2934-46c7-8727-73ff6b6483e8|3'] [Fixed: added para.style.name != 'Title' guard to body paragraph search so it skips the Title paragraph and finds the correct body paragraph]
fix_history: Fix 1: Replaced invalid 8-character suffix '385efeaf' with correct 32-character MD5 hash 'cb7672ac12071a9e4c398d11dc4c470e' in getter function name, metric function name, evaluator.func, and evaluator.result.type

Fix 2: Added 'para.style.name != Title' guard to the body paragraph search loop in getter to exclude the Title-styled paragraph and correctly find the first body paragraph containing 'H2O—SOAK UP THE SCIENCE'

llm_judge_reasons: The previously-flagged bug (body paragraph loop finding the Title-styled paragraph instead of the actual body paragraph) has been fixed: the getter now uses `para.style.name != 'Title'` as a guard (line 36), so it correctly skips the Title paragraph and finds the first non-Title paragraph containing 'H2O—SOAK UP THE SCIENCE'.
Title check is correct: iterates paragraphs with style=='Title' and checks runs for font.subscript=True and '2' in run.text.
Body check is correct after the fix: only considers non-Title paragraphs, avoiding the false-positive/false-negative issue described in the prior judge.
Metric correctly awards 0.5 per condition (subscript_in_title, subscript_in_body) for partial credit; hardcoded logic matches the expected rules dict.
Negative control is sound: original document has no subscript on '2' in either location, so both values default to False and initial state scores 0.0.
Postconfig saves the file with Ctrl+S and waits 2 seconds, ensuring the getter reads the final saved state.
Minor: the `expected` parameter is not used in the metric function, but the hardcoded logic correctly reflects the expected rules.
